ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given points $B$ and $D$ on line segment $AC$, as shown in the figure, if $AC=20$, $AB=8$, and point $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$, what is the length of line segment $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AC=20$ and point $D$ is the midpoint of segment $AC$, \\
$\therefore AD=DC=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times 20=10$, \\
Since $AB=8$, \\
$\therefore BD=AD-AB=10-8=\boxed{2}$.
